items.title: 11.1 Dil (heart) ki banawat aur kaam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and topic 11.1, printed pages 231-238.

blocks.text: Insan ke jism mein mukhtalif cheezon ko jism ke mukhtalif hisson tak pohanchane ke liye do systems hain: blood circulatory system (khoon ka daura karne wala system) aur lymphatic system. Insan ka blood circulatory system band (closed) hai, yani khoon hamesha naliyon ke andar rehta hai. Yeh teen cheezon se bana hai: khoon (blood), dil (heart) aur khoon ki naliyan (blood vessels: arteries, capillaries aur veins).

blocks.title: Yaad karein (Recalling)
blocks.text: Khoon woh mayah (liquid) hai jis ke zariye ghule hue nutrients (ghizai ajza), gases, hormones aur fuzla (wastes) poore jism mein le jaye jate hain. Khoon ke do bare hisse hain: (i) plasma aur (ii) cells ya cell jaisi cheezein (white blood cells, red blood cells aur platelets). Sehatmand insan mein khoon ke hajm (volume) ka taqreeban 55% plasma aur taqreeban 45% cells hote hain.

Insan ka dil ek mehnati pump hai jo khoon ko poore jism mein chalata hai. Yeh seene ke khane (chest cavity) ke beech mein, dono phephron (lungs) ke darmiyan hota hai. Is ki pichli satah reerh ki haddi (vertebral column) ke qareeb hai aur agli satah chhati ki haddi (sternum) aur pasliyon ke cartilages ke peechhe hai.

blocks.title: Dil baen taraf kyun?
blocks.text: Dil aam taur par baen (left) taraf mehsoos hota hai, kyun ke dil ka baan hissa zyada taqatwar aur bara hai; yeh khoon poore jism ko pump karta hai. Dil phephron ke beech mein hai, is liye baan phephra daen se chhota hota hai aur us ke kinare mein dil ke liye jagah banane wala ek khaancha (cardiac notch) hota hai.
Pericardium
Dil ek thaili (sac) mein band hota hai jise pericardium kehte hain (Figure 11.1). Pericardium dil ko aas paas ke aza (organs) se alag rakhta hai. Is ki do tahein (layers) hain:

items: Bahar wali tah fibrous pericardium kehlati hai. Yeh mazboot connective tissue (jorne wala tissue) se bani hai. Yeh dil ko bahar ke dabao (pressure) aur jhatkon (shocks) se bachati hai, aur dil ko had se zyada phailne (excessive dilation) se rokti hai.

Andar wali tah serous pericardium kehlati hai. Yeh khud ek thaili hai jis ki do tahein hain: a) bahar wali parietal pericardium, jo fibrous pericardium ke neeche hai; b) andar wali visceral pericardium (isay epicardium bhi kehte hain), jo dil se bilkul chipki hui hai.

blocks.text: Parietal aur visceral pericardium ke beech ki khali jagah pericardial cavity kehlati hai. Is mein 50 mL tak pericardial fluid hota hai. Yeh fluid dil ko chikna (lubricate) rakhta hai taake ragar na ho, aur dil ko infections se bachata hai.
Dil ki deewar (Wall of the Heart)

Dil ki deewar teen tahon se bani hai. Pericardium ki andar wali tah, yani epicardium, dil ki deewar ki sab se bahar wali tah banati hai. Epicardium ke neeche dil ki deewar ki sab se moti tah myocardium hai, jo cardiac muscles (dil ke pathon) se bani hai. Myocardium ke neeche endocardium hai. Yeh epithelial cells ki sirf ek tah hai aur dil ke khanon (chambers) ki andar ki parat banati hai (Figure 11.1).

blocks.alt: Baen: pericardium ki thaili mein dil, us ki deewar par ek chhota box. Darmiyan: box bara kar ke tahon (layers) mein: fibrous pericardium, phir serous pericardium jo parietal aur visceral pericardium se bana hai aur in ke beech pericardial fluid hai. Daen: dil ki deewar ka tukra, bahar visceral pericardium, beech mein muscle fibres ka mota myocardium aur andar endocardium; is ke aage pericardial fluid aur parietal pericardium.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.1: Pericardium aur dil ki deewar (textbook ki Figure 11.1 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Pericardium, Fibrous pericardium, Serous pericardium, Parietal pericardium, Visceral pericardium, Myocardium, Endocardium, Pericardial fluid.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Visceral pericardium hi dil ki deewar ki bahari tah (epicardium) hai. Parietal aur visceral tahon ke beech pericardial fluid ragar (friction) kam karta hai.
Dil ke khane aur valves (Chambers and Valves of Heart)

Dil ke chaar khane (chambers) hain: oopar do patli deewar wale atria (wahid: atrium) aur neeche do moti deewar wale ventricles. Atria jism se khoon lete hain aur ventricles ko dete hain; ventricles khoon ko jism mein bhejte hain. Atria aur ventricles ke beech atrioventricular septum (parda) hai. Baen aur daen atria ke beech interatrial septum hai. Isi tarah baen aur daen ventricles ke beech interventricular septum hai, jo interatrial septum se kahin zyada mota hai.

Ventricles ke andar aane ke raston par (atrioventricular septum mein) do atrioventricular valves hain: tricuspid valve aur bicuspid valve. Tricuspid valve (teen flaps ya cusps wala) daen atrium aur daen ventricle ke beech hai. Bicuspid (mitral) valve (do cusps wala) baen atrium aur baen ventricle ke beech hai. Jab ventricles sukarte (contract hote) hain to tricuspid aur bicuspid valves band ho jate hain aur khoon ko wapas atria mein jane se rokte hain.

Ventricles se bahar nikalne ke raston par do semilunar valves hain (in ki shakal aadhe chand jaisi hoti hai). Inhen pulmonary valve aur aortic valve kehte hain. Pulmonary valve pulmonary artery ki jar (base) par aur aortic valve aorta ki jar par hai. Jab ventricles dheele (relax) hote hain to pulmonary aur aortic valves band ho jate hain. Is tarah yeh khoon ko pulmonary artery aur aorta se wapas ventricles mein aane se rokte hain.

blocks.alt: Dil ki qash. Superior aur inferior vena cava neela khoon right atrium mein late hain; woh tricuspid valve se right ventricle mein, phir pulmonary valve se pulmonary trunk aur arteries mein jata hai. Pulmonary veins surkh khoon left atrium mein lati hain; woh bicuspid valve se left ventricle mein aur aortic valve se aorta mein jata hai. Septum dono hisson ko alag karta hai. Inset mein chaaron valves oopar se dikhaye gaye hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.2: Insani dil aur valves (textbook ki Figure 11.2 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Superior vena cava, Inferior vena cava, Right atrium, Tricuspid valve, Right ventricle, Pulmonary valve, Pulmonary trunk, Aorta, Pulmonary veins, Left atrium, Bicuspid valve, Aortic valve, Left ventricle; inset: Tricuspid valve, Bicuspid valve, Aortic valve, Pulmonary valve.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tricuspid aur bicuspid valves atria aur ventricles ke beech hain; pulmonary aur aortic (semilunar) valves ventricles se nikalne wali badi naliyon ke shuru mein hain. Teer khoon ka rukh dikhate hain.
Dil mein khoon ka daura (Circulation of Blood through Heart)

Insan ka dil ek double pump (dohra pump) ki tarah kaam karta hai. Yeh pulmonary circulation (phephron ko khoon bhejna) aur systemic circulation (phephron ke siwa jism ke tamam aza ko khoon bhejna) dono karta hai. Dil mein deoxygenated khoon (daen taraf) aur oxygenated khoon (baen taraf) bilkul alag alag rehte hain, aapas mein nahin milte.

Daan atrium jism se deoxygenated khoon do veins ke zariye leta hai: superior vena cava aur inferior vena cava. Daan atrium yeh khoon tricuspid valve se daen ventricle ko deta hai. Jab daan ventricle sukarta hai to deoxygenated khoon semilunar pulmonary valve se guzar kar pulmonary trunk mein jata hai. Pulmonary trunk baen aur daen pulmonary arteries mein bat jata hai jo yeh khoon phephron tak le jati hain.

Phephron se oxygenated khoon pulmonary veins ke zariye baen atrium mein aata hai. Baan atrium yeh khoon bicuspid (ya mitral) valve se baen ventricle ko deta hai. Jab baan ventricle sukarta hai to oxygenated khoon semilunar aortic valve se aorta mein jata hai. Aorta yeh khoon jism ke tamam hisson tak (phephron ke siwa) le jati hai.

blocks.title: Baan ventricle mota kyun?
blocks.text: Baen ventricle ki deewar daen ventricle ki deewar se taqreeban 3 guna moti hai, kyun ke use khoon poore jism mein dhakelna hota hai.
Cardiac cycle: dil ki dharkan (Heartbeat)

Dil musalsal (bina ruke) chakkaron (cycles) mein kaam karta hai. Pehle us ke khane dheele hote hain aur bari veins se khoon khud ba khud (passively) un mein bhar jata hai. Phir khane sukarte hain aur khoon ko poore jism mein dhakelte hain. Dil ka yeh baari baari dheela hona aur sukarna mil kar ek cardiac cycle, yani ek dharkan (heartbeat), kehlata hai.

Jab atria dheele hote hain aur khoon se bhar rahe hote hain, us waqt ventricles bhi dheele hote hain. Dil ke khanon ka yeh dheela daur diastole kehlata hai. Diastole mein dono atria khoon se bhar jate hain. Jaise jaise atria mein khoon jama hota hai, un mein khoon ka dabao barhta hai aur dono atria sukar jate hain. Isay atrial systole kehte hain. Is se khoon tricuspid aur bicuspid valves se guzar kar dono dheele ventricles mein chala jata hai. Jab ventricles khoon se bhar jate hain to dono sukarte hain. Isay ventricular systole kehte hain; is mein khoon pulmonary arteries aur aorta mein pump hota hai. Ventricular systole ke dauran tricuspid aur bicuspid valves band ho jate hain aur pulmonary aur aortic valves khul jate hain.

Ek poori dharkan mein diastole taqreeban 0.4 second, atrial systole taqreeban 0.1 second aur ventricular systole taqreeban 0.3 second leti hai. Insan ki poori zindagi mein dil taqreeban 2.5 billion (250 crore) dafa bina ruke dharakta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen chhote dil ek daire mein, khamdar teeron se jure: diastole (sab khane dheele, 0.4 second) se atrial systole (atria sukarte, gehre surkh, 0.1 second), phir ventricular systole (ventricles sukarte, 0.3 second), aur wapas diastole.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.3: Cardiac cycle (ek dharkan) (textbook ki Figure 11.3 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teeno waqt jama karein: 0.4 + 0.1 + 0.3 = 0.8 second, yani ek dharkan. Is liye dil ek minute mein qareeb 75 baar dharakta hai.
Dharkan ki awazein (Sounds of a Heartbeat)

Jab dono ventricles ek saath sukar kar khoon pulmonary arteries aur aorta mein pump karte hain, to tricuspid aur bicuspid valves band hote hain aur “lubb” ki awaz aati hai. Isi tarah jab ventricular systole khatam hoti hai aur dono ventricles ek saath dheele hote hain, to pulmonary aur aortic semilunar valves band hote hain aur “dubb” ki awaz aati hai. “Lubb-dubb” stethoscope ki madad se suni ja sakti hai.

blocks.title: Heart murmur ka ilaj
blocks.text: Heart murmur ke zyada tar case sangeen (serious) nahin hote. Jo sangeen hon, unhen kharab valves ko masnooi (artificial) valves se, ya kisi organ donor (aza dene wale) ke valves se badal kar theek kiya ja sakta hai.

Agar valves poori tarah band na hon, ya tang (narrow) khulein, to dil ke andar khoon mein halchal (turbulence) paida hoti hai. Yeh halchal heart murmur ke taur par sunai deti hai. Murmur ki awaz seeti ya “hiss” jaisi hoti hai.
Dharkan ka control (Heart Excitation and Contraction)

Dil ki pumping Sinoatrial Node (SA node) shuru karta hai, jise pacemaker bhi kehte hain. SA node cardiac muscle cells ka ek chhota guchha (cluster) hai. Yeh daen atrium ki oopar wali deewar mein dhansa hua hai. Dharkan tab shuru hoti hai jab SA node atria ki deewaron ko electrical impulses (barqi ishare) bhejta hai. Is se dono atria ek saath sukarte hain. Phir yeh impulses atrioventricular node (AV node) tak jate hain. AV node bhi cardiac muscle cells ka chhota guchha hai aur interatrial septum ke nichle hisse mein hota hai.

AV node se impulses atrioventricular bundle (AV bundle), jise bundle of His bhi kehte hain, tak pohanchte hain. Yeh interventricular septum mein fibres (reshon) ka jaal hai. AV bundle baen aur daen shakhon (branches) mein bat jata hai, jo ventricles ki deewaron mein Purkinje fibres par khatam hoti hain. In fibres tak impulse pohanchne se dono ventricles taqreeban ek saath sukarte hain (Figure 11.4). SA node se AV node tak impulse pohanchne mein taqreeban 0.15 second ki der (delay) hoti hai; is der ki wajah se atrial systole poori ho jati hai aur us ke baad ventricular systole shuru hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Dil ki qash aur us ka conducting nizam: right atrium ki oopri deewar mein SA node impulses ko atrial septum ke nichle sire par AV node tak bhejta hai; wahan se AV bundle septum mein neeche jata hai aur right branch aur left branch mein batta hai, jo ventricles ki deewaron mein Purkinje fibres ban kar phailti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.4: Pacemaker aur us ke rabte (textbook ki Figure 11.4 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: SA node, AV node, Right branch of AV bundle, Left branch of AV bundle, Purkinje fibres.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Raasta: SA node (pacemaker) -> AV node (thora ruk kar atria ko pehle sukarne deta hai) -> AV bundle -> right aur left branches -> Purkinje fibres -> ventricles neeche se oopar sukarte hain.

Agar electrical impulses ke raste mein koi rukawat (block) ho, ya SA node ke impulses kamzor hon, to dharkan ki baqaidgi (rhythm) mein der ho sakti hai ya dharkan ruk bhi sakti hai. SA node kamzor ho to aise mareezon mein artificial pacemaker lagaya jata hai. Yeh battery se chalne wala aala (device) hai jo operation (surgery) se lagaya jata hai. Yeh electrical signals bhejta hai jin se dil mamool ke mutabiq dharakta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke artificial pacemaker AV node ke qareeb lagaya jata hai. Asal mein pacemaker ka battery wala hissa aam taur par hansli (collarbone) ke neeche jild ke neeche rakha jata hai, aur us ki patli taarein (leads) veins ke raste dil ke daen atrium ya daen ventricle tak jati hain. Signals in taaron ke sire se dil tak pohanchte hain.
Dharkan ki raftar (Rate of Heartbeat)

Ek aam baligh (adult) insan ka dil ek minute mein taqreeban 70 dafa dharakta hai. Yeh har minute jism ka saara khoon (taqreeban 5 litre) pump kar deta hai. Dharkan ki normal raftar pacemaker aur AV node banate aur qaim rakhte hain. Dimagh (brain) bhi dil ki raftar par kuch asar dalta hai. Maslan bukhar aur warzish (exercise) mein dimagh ka control centre pacemaker aur AV node dono ko nerve signals bhejta hai aur dil ki raftar barh jati hai, taake jism us halat ka muqabla kar sake. Is ke ulat jab hum so rahe hon ya aaram kar rahe hon to dimagh ka control centre pacemaker aur AV node ka kaam dheema kar deta hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Ek baligh insan mein har roz taqreeban 8,000 litre khoon 96,000 km lambi khoon ki naliyon mein se guzarta hai.
Electrocardiogram (ECG)

Cardiac impulses ke current se jo electrical potentials (barqi dabao) bante hain, un ki recording ko electrocardiogram (ECG) kehte hain. Jab cardiac impulse dil ki satah par guzarta hai to ek bohat chhota electrical current paida hota hai. Yeh current dil ke aas paas ke tissues mein phailta hai aur jism ki satah (jild) tak bhi pohanchta hai. ECG mein isi current ke electrical potentials naape aur record kiye jate hain. Is ke liye dil ki mukhalif simton (opposite sides) par jild par electrodes lagaye jate hain. Electrodes ek machine se jure hote hain jise electrocardiograph kehte hain; yeh in potentials ko record karti hai. ECG se dil ke conduction system (impulse chalane wale nizam) ki kharabiyan pehchani jati hain. ECG cardiac cycle ke khaas waqton par banne wali yeh lehrein (waves) dikhata hai (Figure 11.5):

blocks.alt: Oopar: ek ECG lakeer, chhoti P wave, seedha PR segment, lamba QRS complex, seedha ST segment aur gol T wave; ek bracket QT interval dikhata hai. Neeche: chhe chhote dil, har ek ke saath lakeer ka mutabiq hissa rangeen: depolarisation (narangi) SA node se atria aur AV node se ventricles tak phailta hai, phir T wave ke dauran ventricles ka repolarisation (surkh).
blocks.caption: Figure 11.5: Ek dharkan ki ECG reading (textbook ki Figure 11.5 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: P, PR, QRS, ST, T, QT interval, SA node, AV node, Depolarisation, Repolarisation.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: P wave = atria ka depolarisation, QRS = ventricles ka depolarisation, T wave = ventricles ka repolarisation. Atria ka repolarisation QRS ke andar chhup jata hai.

P wave: yeh atria ke depolarization (barqi tabdeeli jis se muscle sukarta hai) ki shuruat dikhati hai, jo SA node shuru karta hai. Is se atria sukarte hain. Agar P waves be-tarteeb hon ya maujood hi na hon to yeh arrhythmia (dharkan ki baqaidgi khatam hona) ki nishani ho sakti hai.

PR segment: yeh atria ke depolarization ka mukammal hona dikhata hai. Normal PR interval (P wave ki shuruat se QRS ki shuruat tak) 0.12 se 0.20 second hota hai. PR interval lamba ho to yeh first-degree heart block ki nishani hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab PR segment ki muddat 0.12 se 0.20 second likhti hai. Yeh asal mein PR interval ki muddat hai (P wave ki shuruat se QRS ki shuruat tak). PR segment (P wave ke khatam hone se QRS ki shuruat tak) is se chhota hai, taqreeban 0.05 se 0.12 second. First-degree heart block mein PR interval 0.20 second se lamba hota hai.

QRS: yeh ventricles ke depolarization ki shuruat dikhata hai. Isi daur mein atria ka re-polarization (wapas aaram ki barqi halat mein aana) bhi hota hai. QRS complex mein kharabi bundle branch block, ventricular tachycardia (ventricles ka bohat tez sukarna) ya ventricles ki kisi aur kharabi ki nishani ho sakti hai.

blocks.title: Blue babies
blocks.text: Kuch bimar bachon ki jild neeli hoti hai (cyanosis); inhen blue babies kehte hain. Aisa is liye hota hai ke dono atria ke beech oxygenated aur deoxygenated khoon mil jata hai. Naye paida hone wale bache ke jism ko mila hua khoon jata hai aur jild neeli ho jati hai. Cyanosis is wajah se hoti hai ke paidaish se pehle ki nashonuma (development) mein interatrial foramen band nahin hota. Interatrial foramen janeen (embryo) ke dil mein daen aur baen atria ke beech ek aarzi surakh hai, jo normal taur par nashonuma mein band ho jata hai. Cyanosis is wajah se bhi ho sakti hai ke ductus arteriosus poori tarah band (constrict) nahin hoti. Ductus arteriosus janeen ki pulmonary artery aur aorta ke beech ek aarzi nali hai, jo normal taur par nashonuma mein band ho jati hai.

ST segment: yeh ventricles ke depolarization ka mukammal hona dikhata hai. Ischemia (dil ke pathon tak khoon aur oxygen ka kam pohanchna) mein yeh neeche (depressed) ho sakta hai aur myocardial infarction (heart attack) mein oopar (elevated) ho sakta hai. Yeh segment aam taur par taqreeban 0.08 second rehta hai.

T wave: yeh ventricles ke repolarization ki shuruat dikhati hai. T wave mein kharabi electrolytes (namkiyat jaise sodium, potassium) ki gar-bar ki nishani ho sakti hai. Hyper-acute (bohat oonchi) T wave acute myocardial infarction ki sab se pehli nishani hoti hai.
QT interval: QRS complex ki shuruat se T wave ke khatam hone tak ka waqt QT interval hai. Normal QT interval aam taur par taqreeban 0.40 second hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek mareez ka ECG mamool ki P wave magar 0.30 second ka PR interval dikhata hai. Conducting nizam ka kaun sa hissa sust hai, aur dil phir bhi tarteeb se kyun dharakta hai?
blocks.explanation: P wave batati hai ke SA node aur atria kaam kar rahe hain, to takheer AV node par hai, jis ki rasai lambi ho gai hai: first-degree heart block. Chunke AV node atria se ventricles tak wahid rasta hai, impulse phir bhi bundle of His aur Purkinje fibres tak pohnchta hai, to ventricles ab bhi atria ke baad sukarte hain, bas mamool ki 0.15 second ki takheer se der se.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Dil phephron ke beech pericardium ki thaili mein hai: bahar fibrous pericardium, andar serous pericardium (parietal aur visceral tahein; beech mein 50 mL tak pericardial fluid). Dil ki deewar: epicardium, myocardium (sab se moti), endocardium.

Chaar khane: oopar patli deewar wale atria, neeche moti deewar wale ventricles (baan ventricle taqreeban 3 guna mota). Tricuspid aur bicuspid (mitral) valves ventricles sukarne par band hote hain; pulmonary aur aortic (semilunar) valves ventricles dheele hone par.
Daen taraf: venae cavae → daan atrium → daan ventricle → pulmonary trunk → phephre. Baen taraf: pulmonary veins → baan atrium → baan ventricle → aorta → jism.
Ek dharkan: diastole 0.4 s, atrial systole 0.1 s, ventricular systole 0.3 s. “Lubb” = AV valves band; “dubb” = semilunar valves band; murmur = kharab valve ki hiss.
SA node (pacemaker) → AV node (0.15 s der) → bundle of His → Purkinje fibres. Minute mein taqreeban 70 dharkanein, har minute 5 litre khoon. ECG: P, PR, QRS, ST, T aur QT.
